caption: Castello Scaligero, Sirmione
composition: Lakeside fortress with swallowtail battlements on Garda · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the water at the brick mass of Castello Scaligero rising from Lake Garda in the flat grey light of the 07:35 morning. Swallowtail battlements crown the walls and the tall central tower, while a stone bridge with a single arch leads diagonally from the lower right to the dark entrance gate at center. Cypress trees stand at the right edge, distant hills fade along the left horizon, and the overcast sky reflects softly on the calm lake.
